description: Key facts for this chapter, written by hand from the chapter text. Every entry links to the section that explains it.

people.name: Sicinius
people.text: The plebeian leader who masterminded the first walkout; later one of the first tribunes.

people.name: Menenius Agrippa
people.text: Former consul who won the strikers back with the fable of the belly.

people.name: Appius Claudius
people.text: The most notorious of the decemvirs, whose tyranny led to the second secession.

people.name: Verginia
people.text: Plebeian girl killed by her own father to save her from Appius Claudius.

people.name: Livy
people.text: The Roman historian who wrote the fullest account of these years, about five centuries later.

dates.text: The last king is driven out; two consuls rule the new Republic.
The debt crisis: a ragged ex-soldier stirs up the Forum.
The first secession to the Sacred Mount.
The first tribunes of the plebs take office.
The *Lex Publilia*: the plebs vote by tribe.
The number of tribunes rises to ten.
The decemvirs are appointed to write down the laws.
The Twelve Tables are published; the second secession ends the decemvirs’ rule.
The Conflict of the Orders ends.
